bio.text: Laura Sturgeon has represented the 4th District in the Delaware Senate since 2018, when she became the first Latina elected to the Delaware State Senate.

Sturgeon is the daughter of Argentine immigrants, graduated from Brandywine High School in 1983, and earned a bachelor's degree in communications and a master's degree in English literature from the University of Delaware.
Sturgeon taught in Delaware public schools for 25 years, retiring in late 2019 from teaching Spanish at Concord High School.
